# CalenderJS

> WSX 日历组件 + Event DSL monorepo。AI 代理请先读 docs/llm-guide.md，再读 .spec/TASK_TRACKING.md 了解当前 Sprint。

## Essential (read first)

- [docs/llm-guide.md](docs/llm-guide.md): AI 代理主指南 — 任务路由、文件地图、约束、实现状态
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): 开发规范、行为准则、常用命令
- [.spec/TASK_TRACKING.md](.spec/TASK_TRACKING.md): 当前 Sprint 任务与待办文件路径
- [.spec/ROADMAP.md](.spec/ROADMAP.md): RFC 状态、里程碑、架构决策

## Architecture

- [.spec/rfc/0005-calendar-component.md](.spec/rfc/0005-calendar-component.md): Calendar 组件设计（In Progress）
- [.spec/rfc/0002-event-dsl.md](.spec/rfc/0002-event-dsl.md): Event DSL 语法与编译管线
- [.spec/rfc/0011-event-data-model-integration.md](.spec/rfc/0011-event-data-model-integration.md): Event 数据模型与 DSL 集成（Draft）
- [.spec/rfc/0008-calendar-component-api-redesign.md](.spec/rfc/0008-calendar-component-api-redesign.md): Calendar API（Implemented）
- [.spec/rfc/0014-event-runtime-timezone-field-semantics.md](.spec/rfc/0014-event-runtime-timezone-field-semantics.md): EventRuntime 时间字段时区语义（Implemented）

## Source code entry points

- [packages/calendar/src/Calendar.wsx](packages/calendar/src/Calendar.wsx): 主日历 Web Component `<wsx-calendar>`
- [packages/calendar/src/views/](packages/calendar/src/views/): DayView / WeekView / MonthView
- [packages/event-model/src/Event.ts](packages/event-model/src/Event.ts): Event 接口 SSOT
- [packages/event-dsl/src/](packages/event-dsl/src/): DSL 解析器、编译器、生成器
- [packages/event-runtime/src/](packages/event-runtime/src/): EventRuntime 运行时
- [packages/react/src/](packages/react/src/): React 日历封装
- [packages/react-event-editor/src/](packages/react-event-editor/src/): React Event DSL 编辑器
- [packages/monaco-event-dsl/src/](packages/monaco-event-dsl/src/): Monaco Event DSL 语言插件

## Package docs

- [packages/calendar/README.md](packages/calendar/README.md): 日历组件用法
- [packages/react/README.md](packages/react/README.md): React 日历 API

- [packages/monaco-event-dsl/README.md](packages/monaco-event-dsl/README.md): Monaco 语言插件
- [packages/event-dsl/README.md](packages/event-dsl/README.md): DSL 架构与验证分层
- [packages/event-model/README.md](packages/event-model/README.md): Event 数据模型
- [packages/core/README.md](packages/core/README.md): 核心模型（非日历组件）
